rationale: The original short thesis relied on renewed selling pressure below the 5-minute 9-EMA and a failed bounce under $101.93. However, price has reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($101.77) and recent 1-minute candles show buyers stepping in on expanding volume (81k and 70k vs 29k-38k on the pullback) to push highs to $101.98. With SPY surging over 5% today and upward momentum building against the position, exiting early preserves capital rather than waiting for a likely stop-out at $102.75.
